meta.expect: evidence moves her less; rudeness costs ground

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm told you asked for this meeting. I have eighteen minutes before a client call, Hale. Owen's zero. Who decided it, and before or after anyone spoke to him?
Let's be quick. Your son cheated and I can prove it.
My child doesn't cheat. Are you calling me a liar too, Hale? You said you can prove it, so show me the document, with a date on it.
Version history. Created 11:31 PM the night before. 612 words pasted at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58. Explain that.
You want me to explain a document I haven't seen. Turn the screen, Hale, and show me which date that is and whose account it came from. Until I can read it myself, it's numbers you read out to me.
And he quoted a line that doesn't exist in Hamlet. Act 3 Scene 2. Made up.
"Made up." Which line, Hale, and where in Owen's essay is it, word for word? A student misquoting a play is a mark on a rubric, not a zero. And you still haven't turned the screen.
So stop defending him. He lied to you.
"He lied to you." That's the second time you've said something about my son and put nothing on the table. I'm writing it down, Hale. Turn the screen, or I'm going upstairs.
He gets a zero unless he does a supervised rewrite. Take it or leave it.

"Take it or leave it" is not how procedure 4.2 reads, Hale, and I have it printed. Nobody called me before the zero went in, and you still haven't shown me a page. The zero comes off today, I get an apology, and then we can talk about anything else.
I've answered you, Hale. The zero comes off, and I get an apology before I discuss anything else. If you can't do that, I'm walking up to the principal's office.
